demo.title: teslr.sh
demo.code:
# Compare multiple vehicles in one request
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to tell me my Model 3 mileage and Model Y tire pressures"

# Mix commands and reads; approve the command preview
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to lock my Model 3 and check software updates on both cars"

# Discover connected energy products
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to check whether I have any connected energy sites"

# Read richer Tesla metadata
bankr prompt "Use Teslr to check service notices and warranty information"

setup: Connect directly at https://teslr.club, then save the one-time token as TESLR_FLEET_TOKEN in Bankr Terminal -> Settings -> Env Vars
For direct vehicle commands, approve the Teslr virtual key for each vehicle in the Tesla app
The same skill works with other command-capable agents: keep its scripts and references together, use Node.js 22+, and supply TESLR_FLEET_TOKEN through the host's secure environment
Keep tokens private: never paste them into a prompt, chat, or public X post
